title: Winged Angel in Poppy Field
description: A barefoot man with large feathered wings and a glowing halo walks along a stone path through a vast field of red poppies. Behind him stand ancient ruined columns under a dramatic sky filled with colorful paint splatters and drips.
prompt: A barefoot young man with curly hair, large white feathered angel wings, and a glowing halo walks toward the viewer on a broken stone path through a dense field of vibrant red poppies. He wears a flowing beige robe. Behind him are ancient Greek or Roman stone ruins. The sky is filled with dramatic clouds and colorful paint splatters and drips in red, green, purple, and gold. Cinematic lighting, surreal atmosphere.
